item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00440","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C02","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Its first, second, and fourth sections closely match the child's sequence: transfer specified functions to an administrator; provide for their administration by that administrator or designated subordinate personnel subject to direction and control; and transfer related records, property, and unexpended funds. The child adapts this machinery to move the remaining and liquidation functions of the same Small Defense Plants Administration to the Small Business Administrator. C02 has a similarly close termination-and-transfer structure, but its wording and sequence are less directly aligned.
